verdict.rationale: Agent attribution is a fair question for an agent-payments protocol, but the evidence pack never documents attributing orders to an originating agent or reporting and filtering transactions by agent. The facilitator only 'reports the result' of a settlement to the resource server, and agentic accounts are a buyer-side funding feature, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
